method.workload: scripts/perf/collapse.sh --target local --ram scripts/perf/ram.json; four paired runs, identical temporary CPU/body/cast probes; a separate auxiliary driving run is not part of the comparison.
method.conditions: MEASURED local Apple M4, available parallelism 10, compute/async/io pools 10/1/1; unattended, muted, headless, one game run under the machine lock; no attached profiler. Not a hosted-allocation price.
method.budget: DERIVED 15625 microseconds from the admitted fixed timestep of 0.015625 seconds.
method.MEASURED_fields: Tick/phase/cast/query/resolve wall durations, process CPU duration, source identities and velocities, source/cast/joint visit counts, and observed release verdicts.
method.DERIVED_fields: Kinetic energy, minimum separation-work bounds, energy classifications, statistics calculated from measured rows, and off-CPU lower bounds.
method.kinetic_energy: K = (m v dot v + omega dot I_world omega)/2, sampled before sweep effects using Avian computed mass and occupied angular inertia.
method.joint_work: For each live joint incident to the pre-resolution occupied inward patch, A*min(G_I,G_II); cracked seams and rests contribute zero. The intact-bond bound excludes these zero-work joints. Minimum across reached live joints and owners. Null means no reached live joint/bond of that category.
method.joint_work_limit: These are necessary pulse-work lower bounds from fracture::parts::Assessment::bonded_verdict, not sufficient failure energies: the law also checks strength and sums interface work. Sustained loads can part a joint without this pulse-work gate. sweep::Geometry::resolve uses Hertz peak force, drive and directional min-cut capacity, with no kinetic-energy spending gate. No kinetic-energy-only skip is certified by these data.
method.casts: Work::casts counts exact source-leaf/target-leaf Motion::hit attempts; its time includes all nested time_of_impact retries. Body cast counts sum exactly to SweepAccount on every recorded over-budget tick.
method.body_cost_limit: Body geometry and resolve times are worker durations and can overlap. Shared source admission, owner preload, release preparation and ordered effects remain in the sweep wall stage; the body times are not an additive decomposition of that wall stage.
method.attribution: Each additive stage/phase of every complete-capture over-budget tick is retained. Inclusive physics, collector and send are not double-counted. Collector/send are outside tick wall.
method.awake: The ram awake count is construction Piece + Breakage without Sleeping; it excludes the tank. Zero awake rubble is not an idle world.
method.archived_probes: Local target/rubble8-main-probe.patch, target/rubble8-lane-probe.patch, target/rubble8-drive-probe.patch; active probes are removed before the report commit.
method.body_units: MEASURED speed is m/s and spin is rad/s; DERIVED kinetic energy and work bounds are joules. Body identities are run-local entity bits.

historical_session7.limit: All 181 excess overruns are late with zero casts. Extra period CPU consumption rules out a pure process-pause-only explanation, but old records lack complete phases and per-tick CPU; the exact historical work site cannot be recovered. New runs localize much of the recurring late cost to FixedUpdate. The auxiliary probe identifies current driving work; it does not retroactively instrument the historical run.
historical_session7.current_evidence: MEASURED current paired late FixedUpdate means are 6.328 ms and 4.788 ms. In the separate auxiliary run, driving accounts for DERIVED 95.503% of late FixedUpdate; force evaluation averages MEASURED 4.227 ms wall and 5.215 ms process CPU. This supports state-dependent driving computation as a candidate for the historical tail; the historical exact site remains unproven.
historical_session7.comparison_limit: The paired lane runs do not replay the old terminal states: source/awake counters begin differing at contact +5 for A and +8 for B; terminal body/joint counts also differ. New driving timings locate current work, not the historical exact site.

precontact_stall.limit: Off-CPU delay is established, not whether it was OS descheduling or blocking. The historical 58.252750 ms tick has no per-tick CPU sample and cannot be classified retrospectively.

auxiliary_drive.method: Separate auxiliary tracked ram, with the paired probes plus temporary driving phase wall/CPU brackets and unique nearby support-collider count. It does not replace or join the four-run comparison. Counts label support colliders, not only free bodies. Phase CPU sums may overlap independent process work. All probes removed before commit.
